visual.title: How digital contracts and escrow payments work for IT projects
visual.subtitle: We do not ask for blind trust. We show exactly how identity, money, and delivery are protected before you enter the platform.

step_one.label: STEP 1
step_one.title: Both sides enter verified
step_one.body: The company and the professional go through real checks before they collaborate, reducing risk from the very first contact.

step_two.label: STEP 2
step_two.title: Funds enter escrow before work starts
step_two.body: The client secures the milestone first, and the provider knows the work starts with reserved funds, not promises.

step_three.label: STEP 3
step_three.title: Every milestone leaves a clear trail
step_three.body: Statuses, approvals, and cryptographic proof create an audit trail that both sides can follow easily.

contract.title: Contract flow prepared for launch
contract.footer: This is what we are opening now for the initial cohort: IT collaborations that are clear, protected, and easy to control.
